filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 5 Arabic videos covering all specified ANOVA topics. The chosen videos are highly relevant, well-produced, and have significant view counts, indicating their effectiveness as educational resources. For each topic, selections were made that directly address the conceptual challenges students face, such as calculation walkthroughs, assumption explanations, and result interpretation guides.
